strategic_recommendations: Add a 2‑second visual hook (e.g., a striking close‑up or bold text) before any narration to lock viewers in.
Incorporate at least one slow‑motion or hyper‑zoom clip per video to boost replay value and match competitor visual style.
Rotate title formulas weekly: use the three proven patterns (What If, The Secret, Superlative) and A/B test emoji placement to refine click‑through rates.
